snippet.description:

If you have any questions, feel free to ask and I'll happily respond in the comments! Thanks for reading.

snippet.title: TK Kader
snippet.description:
Helping B2B AI and SaaS Founders scale to $10M+ ARR (and beyond) using the Unstoppable GTM Framework. New videos every Sunday.

Hi, I’m TK. I’m the Founder of the Unstoppable GTM Program. I help Founders go from an undefined GTM strategy, or the one you have now, and transform it into a well defined and scalable GTM strategy.

In a world where software is easier than ever to build, I believe Distribution and a Scalable GTM Strategy is the ultimate moat.

At my last startup (ToutApp), I raised from the best VC firms in the world (a16z, JSV, Founder Collective, Launch) and built it to a category defining business. And at Marketo (after exiting ToutApp to them), I worked with one of the best PE firms (Vista) and helped exit it for $4.75bn to Adobe.

Through my journey as a Founder, I've learned how to start, scale, and exit software businesses. This is why I've taken everything I've learned and distilled it down into actionable strategies that I teach on this YouTube channel.
